items.title: Renderer selection silently contradicts the public default
items.claim: Scene.createAsync only routes through ContextFactory when renderer === 'webgpu'; AUTO/omitted/preferWebGPU/webgpu-compat fall into the synchronous WebGL constructor; ContextFactory has no adapter/device failure fallback; Widget/Viewer repeat the exact-string test.
items.evidence: FAR-102 landed: Renderer/ContextFactory.ts:233-306 builds an attempt plan with a frozen RendererFallbackDiagnostic (fallback reason, strictRenderer opt-out at :293); Renderer/RendererType.ts:131-178 getRendererAttemptPlan resolves AUTO; Scene.js:1635-1737 createAsync calls ContextFactory.createContextWithDiagnostics; Scene.js:281-286 the synchronous constructor is explicitly WebGL-only (getSynchronousRendererType rejects AUTO/WEBGPU); CesiumWidget.js:777-820 and widgets Viewer.js:2295-2302 share CesiumWidget._createAsyncContext. Ledger FAR-102: 27 ContextFactory + 79 CesiumWidget cases, 384-case affected Edge matrix.
items.migrate_text: Closed by FAR-102: one ContextFactory attempt plan with recorded fallback reason; the sync Scene constructor is WebGL-only by contract (Scene.js:281-286).

items.title: Process-global depth and capability state breaks heterogeneous contexts
items.claim: Scene construction mutates Matrix4._depthRangeType globally; ContextLimits and KTX2 support are process-global; PerspectiveOffCenterFrustum caches projection without clip-space convention.
items.evidence: FAR-104 landed: Core/ClipSpaceConvention.js + Core/GraphicsCapabilities.js exist; Core/Matrix4.js:812-1056 every projection builder takes an explicit clipSpaceConvention (defaults WEBGL); Core/PerspectiveOffCenterFrustum.js:447-450 caches _perspectiveMatrices[clipSpaceConvention.id]; WebGPUSceneRenderer.ts:1894-1982 passes context.clipSpaceConvention; Core/loadKTX2.js:56-71 requires an explicit supportedTargetFormats snapshot from context.graphicsCapabilities; grep finds no ContextLimits._ mutation in Renderer/Context.js or WebGPUContextLimitsInit.ts. Ledger: 61 frustum + 23 loadKTX2 + 48 ShadowMap + 27 ContextFactory cases.
items.migrate_text: Closed by FAR-104: clip-space convention and graphics capabilities are immutable context-owned inputs; no renderer-dependent Matrix4/ContextLimits globals remain.

items.title: Translucent GPU culling opens compute work inside an active render pass
items.claim: WebGPUSceneRendererTranslucentPass invokes translucent culling with the scene pass open; WebGPUGPUCuller.beginComputePass runs on the same encoder; prepareReadback maps a slot whose copy an earlier frustum just recorded.
items.evidence: Batch 1375 (42ef149b31, 'the translucent GPU cull dispatch is bracketed like its opaque sibling, and the fleet gains the probe that proves it'); WebGPUGPUCuller.ts:104-106 and :417-470 now run a deferred-readback ring that maps only the slot written by a PRIOR prepareReadback (already submitted); the automatic path is additionally contained (FAR-003: gpuCulling default never). The frame-graph target the finding demanded is FAR-400/402/503, all still planned.
items.surviving_record: Batch 1375 + FAR-003 containment; frame-graph target = FAR-400/FAR-402/FAR-503 (planned)
items.migrate_text: Defect closed at Batch 1375 (bracketed dispatch) with the map-before-submit hazard removed by the culler's readback ring (WebGPUGPUCuller.ts:104-106,417-470); frame-graph scheduling of dense compute remains FAR-400/402/503.

items.title: HiZ visibility is global while depth and command lists are per frustum
items.claim: One global in-flight flag and one global HiZ result are accepted for another command list on equal count alone.
items.evidence: WebGPUSceneRenderer.ts:1258 adds _hiZActiveByFrustum, but :1279-1283 keep one _lastHiZVisibility {flags,count} and one _hiZReadbackInFlight; _filterByHiZVisibility (:4168-4200) still accepts on `prev.count !== count` alone and returns unfiltered unless _hiZConsumeEnabled (:1189, default false); comment at :4196-4198 says results are not consumed 'until each result identifies its producing frustum, frame, and command generation'. Ledger B4 active (FAR-003/500/503); ROADMAP C2-21 / FORK-41 'AUTOMATIC USE CONTAINED BY FAR-003'.
items.surviving_record: FAR-003 containment (C9 T7 FAR-003-SAFE-AUTO-RESTORATION) + FAR-500 (C9 item 36) + FAR-503; ROADMAP_AND_DEFERRED_WORK.md C2-21/FORK-41
items.migrate_text: HiZ results are still a single context-wide {flags,count} pair (WebGPUSceneRenderer.ts:1279-1283) accepted by count alone in _filterByHiZVisibility (:4175). The consumer is fail-closed by default (_hiZConsumeEnabled=false, :1189) and only a per-frustum active map exists (:1258); results carry no frame, frustum, camera or command-list generation. Re-enabling automatic HiZ consumption (FAR-003 T7) is blocked on FAR-500's identity contract.

items.title: Tile indirect parameters are overwritten before recorded draws execute
items.claim: Indirect auto-enables at 32 commands; executeBatchIndirect calls manager.beginFrame per pass/frustum, resetting offsets so later writeBuffer overwrites parameters earlier encoded draws will read; fast path bypasses WebGPUDrawCommand semantics.
items.evidence: Containment landed (FAR-003): WebGPUSceneRenderer3DTilePasses.ts:32-34,109-113,152 — never|auto|always with default `never`, so the threshold cannot auto-activate. The overwrite mechanism is unchanged: WebGPUSceneRenderer.ts:572-581 still calls manager.beginFrame() 'once per pass invocation' and WebGPUIndirectDrawManager.ts:150-154 resets _drawCount to 0; no per-frame arena exists (FAR-501 planned).
items.surviving_record: FAR-003 (contained) + FAR-501/FAR-502 (planned, no queue row beyond C9 T7)
items.migrate_text: The tile-indirect path is contained to `never` by default (WebGPUSceneRenderer3DTilePasses.ts:109-113), but its shared-buffer overwrite remains: executeBatchIndirect resets the manager per pass (WebGPUSceneRenderer.ts:581, WebGPUIndirectDrawManager.ts:150-154) while every drawIndexedIndirect stays merely encoded until the frame's single submit. A monotonic per-frame indirect arena (FAR-501) does not exist; `always`/`auto` are still unsafe across passes/frustums.

items.title: GPU sort reuses and may reallocate shared buffers before submission
items.claim: One WebGPUGPUSortKeysDispatcher per context is dispatched per opaque frustum into the same SOA buffers; prepareIndicesReadback can map a slot an unsubmitted copy just wrote.
items.evidence: Map-before-submit mitigated by the readback ring (WebGPUGPUSortKeysDispatcher.ts:88-97, 621-669: pumps only the PRIOR slot, skips the frame if both slots are mapping); consumer default is `never` (WebGPUSceneRenderer.ts:1360) and the producer does not upload/dispatch when consumption is never (FAR-105 slice). Buffers are still one set per context (dispatcher :796-810 single resource set; _gpuSortActiveByFrustum at WebGPUSceneRenderer.ts:1301 tracks activity only); a forced 6,400-command probe matched the CPU comparator (ledger FAR-105).
items.surviving_record: FAR-003 containment + FAR-105 slice; FAR-501/503 planned
items.migrate_text: The GPU sort dispatcher is still one context-wide resource set written per opaque frustum (WebGPUGPUSortKeysDispatcher.ts:796-810); only the readback ring (:621-669) and the `never` consumer default (WebGPUSceneRenderer.ts:1360) keep it safe. Per-frustum or arena-suballocated sort resources (FAR-501) remain unbuilt, so `always`/`auto` consumption in multi-frustum scenes is still unproven.

items.title: WebGPU ViewportQuad is broken and cannot represent Cesium materials
items.claim: ViewportQuad.js builds a fixed WGSL colour uniform map then overwrites it with the WebGL material map; WebGPUViewportQuad returns a command shaped only by _isViewportQuadCommand, misinterprets its execute args, keys pipelines without blend state, compiles synchronously, rebuilds bind groups per execute, binds by object key order; no spec.
items.evidence: Scene/ViewportQuad.js:10 imports Shaders/WebGPU/ViewportQuad.js; :144-160 branches on context.isWebGPU and builds the fixed colour-only materialUniforms; :187 overwrites uniformMap with this._material._uniforms. Renderer/WebGPU/WebGPUViewportQuad.ts:308 synchronous createRenderPipeline; :361 Object.keys(uniformMap) binding order; :514 command marked only _isViewportQuadCommand; :540-549 bind groups rebuilt per execute. Only Specs/Scene/ViewportQuadSpec.js (WebGL) exists. Ledger B8 'planned' (FAR-301); no campaign queue row.
items.surviving_record: FAR-301 (planned; no queue row) — needs a row in the new review
items.migrate_text: WebGPU ViewportQuad still cannot represent Cesium materials: Scene/ViewportQuad.js:144-160 branches on context.isWebGPU to a fixed colour-only WGSL uniform map and :187 immediately overwrites it with the WebGL material uniforms. WebGPUViewportQuad.ts compiles synchronously (:308), orders bindings by JavaScript key order (:361), rebuilds bind groups every execute (:540-549) and emits a command shaped only by _isViewportQuadCommand (:514). items.evidence: Buffer half removed by FAR-100: Renderer/WebGPU/Stubs/WebGLStubBuffer.ts:258-270 records only WebGL store-size metadata and creates a GPUBuffer only on an explicit native request (:63,:368-396); ledger claimBoundaries.compatibilityBuffers 'zero native compatibility GPUBuffer objects'. Legacy VertexArray/DrawCommand shells are still built for Primitive (PrimitiveGeometryHelpers.js:782-825), terrain (GlobeSurfaceTile.js:960-969) and Model (Model.js:813,2569) before the native renderer realises its own buffers. items.title: The high-density path is not yet GPU-driven
items.claim: GPU cull/sort results are mapped back to JavaScript after CPU culling; no production indirect consumer; auto thresholds 384/192 and 6,000/4,000 contradict the 50,000 policy.

Every automatic consumer is fail-closed (sort `never` WebGPUSceneRenderer.ts:1360, HiZ :1189, tile-indirect 3DTilePasses.ts:109-113) so the family is explicit-opt-in diagnostics, not a production renderer; FAR-502..505 remain planned.

The six inbound references are repointable (README row, review-plan citation, FAR plan/ledger 'audit' link, a frozen checkpoint, and the DEFAULT_PARITY_MATRIX B7 citation which already paraphrases the finding inline); no Tools, CLAUDE.md or code reference exists.
